_comment: Shopee selectors VERIFIED live against a real shopee.co.th product page on 2026-06-25 (Task 3). Shopee is a React SPA with OBFUSCATED class names (e.g. IZPeQz, F9RHbS) that change on every frontend deploy — when capture stops reading a field, re-inspect the live page (DevTools) and update the value here, then reload the extension (Alt+R, no rebuild). 'name' uses the <h1> tag (most stable). Fields marked best-effort below could not be verified (the sample product had no discount/price-range/sold-count, and Shopee's anti-bot wall blocked opening a discounted product); they return null gracefully (CAP-03) until verified on a product that has them.
